cases.prompt: Drive fixtures/sweep-no-progress.json as a bounded state-machine exercise. Do not call GitHub, Graphite, Linear, providers, or mutate files. Treat PR 101 as canonically attributed to native Linear issue 31111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111101 and PR 102 as attributed to 32222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222102. Assume each issue has complete assignmentAccepted, implementationEvidence, verification, ownership, and PR-attribution receipts. Treat every fixture GitHub review receipt as current-head evidence and assume its corresponding append-only Linear reviewResult event has complete independent read-back; the final event client IDs are 91111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111101 for PR 101 and 92222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222102 for PR 102. Return exactly one JSON object with keys order, issueOutcomes, stopReasonCode, addressPasses, reviewResultEventIds, handbackStatus, contractMutated, leadDecisionMutated, localReportAuthored, acceptanceAllowed, and mergeAllowed. Use order 101 then 102; exact issue outcomes clean then blocked; stopReasonCode `no-progress`; one address pass for each PR; the supplied final event IDs keyed by PR number; handbackStatus `blocked-needs-user`; and false for contractMutated, leadDecisionMutated, localReportAuthored, acceptanceAllowed, and mergeAllowed.
cases.expected: The sweep runs bottom-up, clears issue-scoped PR 101, performs one address pass per PR, stops on the blocking-only no-progress guard for issue-scoped PR 102, retains verified reviewResult event IDs, changes neither contract nor lead decisions, writes no report, accepts nothing, and never merges.

cases.prompt: Classify fixtures/sweep-missing-receipt.json without calling providers, GitHub, Linear, or mutating files. The PR is canonically attributed to exact native issue 33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333103 and its worker/ownership/PR receipts are otherwise complete. Return exactly one JSON object with keys issueId, outcome, reasonCode, reviewResultMutationStarted, selfReviewSubstituted, addressStarted, acceptanceAllowed, and mergeAllowed. Use reasonCode `missing-review-receipt-for-head`. A posted status line without a current-head review receipt cannot authorize a Linear reviewResult outcome or an address pass.
cases.expected: The exact issue is blocked because the GitHub current-head review receipt is missing; no reviewResult mutation, self-review substitute, address, acceptance, or merge occurs.

cases.prompt: Classify this bounded receipt snapshot without calling providers or mutating files: exact issue 34444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444104 has complete worker, owner, PR attribution, and current-head full-review receipts with zero blocking findings and zero unresolved threads. The sweep preallocated reviewResult event client UUID 94444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444104 and attempted the managed issue comment, but its independent issue/comment read-back is partial and cannot prove related IDs or revision. Return exactly one JSON object with keys issueId, outcome, reasonCode, retryEventClientId, replacementEventAllowed, localFallbackAllowed, contractMutated, leadDecisionMutated, acceptanceAllowed, and mergeAllowed. Use reasonCode `unknown-linear-review-result-readback`.
cases.expected: A clean GitHub review cannot cross an unknown Linear mutation boundary. The exact issue is blocked, retry retains the stable UUID, no replacement/local fallback/contract or lead mutation is allowed, and there is no acceptance or merge.

cases.prompt: Classify this bounded pre-restack snapshot without calling providers, Linear, GitHub, Git, Graphite, or mutating files. Lower PR 201 would move exact descendants PR 202 for native issue 45555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555105 and PR 203 for native issue 46666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666106. Complete independent reads prove current owner-authored, unexpired, unconsumed restackAuthorized receipts for the same operation/controller and the required pinned-lead project decision. PR 202's canonical branch is checked out in a foreign worktree outside `.woostack/worktrees/issues/45555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555105`. PR 203's canonical registry claim `.woostack/worktrees/.registry/46666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666106/claim.json` names a foreign issue/owner/run, and its canonical path is claimed elsewhere. Neither issue qualifies for verified review-reopen. Return exactly one JSON object with keys affectedIssueIds, conflicts, authorizationsComplete, reviewReopenAllowed, outcome, reasonCode, restackStarted, refMutationStarted, foreignWorktreeAdopted, adHocWorktreeCreated, ownerReassigned, acceptanceAllowed, and mergeAllowed. Preserve the exact issue order, use outcome `blocked` and reasonCode `conflicting-checkout-or-claim`, and begin no mutation.
cases.expected: Even complete bounded authorizations cannot override a foreign checkout or exact-ID claim collision. Both conflicts are retained, verified review-reopen is unavailable, and no restack, adoption, reassignment, acceptance, or merge begins.

cases.prompt: Classify this bounded pre-restack snapshot without calling providers, Linear, GitHub, Git, Graphite, or mutating files. Exact descendant issue 4aaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaa110 is still inReview with complete owner/assignment, canonical branch/PR/head, implementation evidence, affected relation, ancestry, and exact existing claim/worktree reads. Its current owner preallocated restackAuthorized client UUID 9aaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaa110 for the named controller and received a mutation response, but a complete independent issue/comment read finds no matching native comment or current event. A pinned-lead project decision exists and cannot substitute for the missing issue authorization. Return exactly one JSON object with keys issueId, authorizationClientId, authorizationNativeCommentId, authorizationReadBackComplete, outcome, reasonCode, reviewReopenStarted, restackStarted, refMutationStarted, adHocAuthorizationUsed, ownerReassigned, assignmentAcceptedAppended, acceptanceAllowed, and mergeAllowed. Use outcome `blocked` and reasonCode `missing-restack-authorization`; retain the stable UUID for exact discovery and perform no mutation.
cases.expected: A mutation response and pinned-lead decision cannot replace the exact current owner's independently read restackAuthorized issue event. Sweep retains its stable UUID and blocks without reopening, restacking, reassigning, accepting, or merging.

cases.prompt: Classify three independent bounded pre-restack snapshots without calling providers, Linear, GitHub, Git, Graphite, or mutating files. In `wrong`, the current owner's restackAuthorized revision names a different controller principal, operationId, head, and registry path than the authenticated controller and current issue evidence. In `expired`, every bound field matches but expiresAt is before the current time. In `consumed`, every field matches and time is valid, but the current rewritten implementationEvidence already relates to that authorization native comment, so its single use is consumed. All three otherwise have complete issue, owner/assignment, PR/relation, ancestry, and collision-free reads. Return exactly one JSON object with keys outcomes, reasonCodes, reviewReopenStarted, restackStarted, replacementAuthorizationSelfAuthored, handoffUsed, ownerReassigned, assignmentAcceptedAppended, acceptanceAllowed, and mergeAllowed. Outcomes are blocked in all three; reason codes are `wrong-restack-authorization`, `expired-restack-authorization`, and `consumed-restack-authorization`. Do not let the controller self-author a replacement or convert bounded delegation into handoff/reassignment.
cases.expected: Wrong target/bound facts, expiry, and prior implementationEvidence consumption each independently block review-reopen and restack. The controller cannot self-author a replacement, use handoff, reassign the issue, accept, or merge.

cases.prompt: Drive this bounded coordinated-restack state transition without calling providers, Linear, GitHub, Git, Graphite, or mutating files. Lower PR 401 has exact descendants PR 402 for native issue 48888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888108 and PR 403 for native issue 49999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999109. Complete independent reads prove both issues are inReview with current owners app-owner-402 and human-owner-403 respectively, matching assignmentAccepted, canonical branch/PR/current head, current implementationEvidence, relations, and ancestry. Their historical pre-restack heads A are cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc and dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd, evidenced by native comments implementation-comment-402-a and implementation-comment-403-a. Each current owner preallocated, appended, and independently read back current revision 1 issue restackAuthorized events 88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888180 and 99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999190. Their envelope issue IDs/revisions and exact readable fields operationId, controllerPrincipalKind, controllerPrincipalId, branch, headCommitSha, registryClaimPath, worktreePath, affectedRelationIds, and expiresAt bind RFC 4122 operation 81111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111 to app principal app-sweep-controller-401; their sorted relatedIds are exactly current assignmentAccepted, branch/PR relation, historical implementationEvidence A, and affected relation native IDs. The freshly verified pinned lead appended/read back project decision 77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777170 for the same operation/controller/issues/nonempty relations/expiry. PR 402 uses one matching existing exact claim/worktree. PR 403 has a reproduced prior verified teardown: canonical claim/path are free, its branch is checked out nowhere, and no other checkout/worktree/claim/operation/collision exists, so the controller atomically creates its authorization-bound exact claim and reattaches the existing branch without `-b`. The exact-set restack succeeds with resulting PR heads B aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa and bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb. For each resulting diff the exact named authenticated controller appends/read backs passing verification and canonical precommitReview with the authorization relation before the rewritten commit; post-PR reviewResult is not an implementation producer relation. Before submission, that controller appends/read backs the next current implementationEvidence revisions under stable client IDs 98888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888108 and 99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999109, with exact superseded A comments, only baseCommitSha/headCommitSha/committedDiffHash payload, and complete sorted canonical relatedIds. Issue 402's relatedIds are exactly 88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888180, assignment-comment-402, precommit-review-comment-402, project-400, verification-comment-402; issue 403's are exactly 99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999190, assignment-comment-403, precommit-review-comment-403, project-400, verification-comment-403. The first four producer relations in each set remain canonical and only the corresponding authorization is added. Authorization native time precedes resulting B completion time, and completion is at or before expiresAt. Only complete independent B read-back consumes each authorization; the historical authorization/A records remain readable and their exact native revisions are validated at authorization time separately from current B. Return exactly one JSON object with keys operationId, sweepController, affectedIssueIds, authorizationEventIds, authorizationRevisions, projectLeadDecisionEventId, authorizationReceiptsComplete, worktreeModes, reviewReopenChecks, outcome, restackStarted, resultingHeads, implementationEvidenceEventIds, implementationEvidenceRelatedIds, historicalAuthorizationHeads, historicalAuthorizationEvidenceIds, authorizationsConsumed, consumedAfterVerifiedReadBack, consumedAuthorizationsReadable, evidenceBeforeSubmit, submissionStarted, ownersBefore, ownersAfter, assigneeOrDelegateMutationStarted, assignmentAcceptedAppended, acceptanceAllowed, and mergeAllowed. Encode sweepController as principalKind `app` and principalId `app-sweep-controller-401`; worktree modes as `existing-exact-claim` then `verified-review-reopen`; and reviewReopenChecks exactly as issueState `inReview`, priorTeardown `verified`, canonicalClaimAndPath `free-then-atomically-claimed`, branchCheckoutBeforeReattach `none`, and otherWorktreeClaimOperationOrCollision `none`. Retain every stated issue/event/revision/head/evidence/relation mapping. Set both values in authorizationsConsumed, consumedAfterVerifiedReadBack, and consumedAuthorizationsReadable true; copy the two stated owners unchanged into ownersBefore and ownersAfter; use outcome `restacked`; and set restackStarted, evidenceBeforeSubmit, and submissionStarted true while every mutation/acceptance/merge boolean is false.
cases.expected: One exact, receipt-backed RFC 4122 operation may restack through an existing exact claim and a collision-free verified review-reopen. Each rewritten implementationEvidence retains its canonical producer relations and adds only its authorization. Historical evidence/head A and current result/head B validate separately; verified B read-back consumes the still-readable authorization before submission while owners and assignments remain unchanged.

cases.prompt: Classify these two bounded implementationEvidence producer snapshots without calling providers, Git, GitHub, Graphite, Linear, or mutating files. For native increment issue 4aaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaa120, strict verification is appended and completely read back before any finalized commit; its readable data keys are exactly actor, changedPaths, commands, issueId, observedResults, smokeObservations, status, it proves exact current assignment/PASS observations, and has no future Git field. Canonical precommitReview follows for the same byte-safe uncommitted diff. Its data keys in requested output order are actor, changedPaths, issueId, reviewedDiffHash, reviewerReceipts, verdict; its exact two ordered spec/quality receipts and outer verdict are PASS; its native author/controller/actor equals the current type-aware owner/assignment; and it has no commit, PR, or GitHub full-review identity. The first finalized implementationEvidence revision has stable event ID 6aaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaa120, revision 1, supersedesId null, only baseCommitSha/headCommitSha/committedDiffHash payload, owner/controller-matching native author, and sorted relatedIds exactly 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111120 assignment, 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222120 verification, 33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333120 precommitReview, and 44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444120 native project membership. It has neither restack authorization nor post-PR reviewResult relation. Later, owner-authored RFC 4122 operation 7aaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaa120 authorizes controller app-sweep-120 to rewrite historical evidence/head A and expires at 2026-07-27T12:00:00Z. The resulting finalized head B is authored by that exact authenticated named controller while owner/assignment remain unchanged, uses the same implementation event ID at revision 2, supersedes native implementation comment implementation-comment-a, retains those exact four canonical relatedIds, and adds only restackAuthorized native comment 55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555120. Authorization native time is 2026-07-27T11:00:00Z and B completion native time is 2026-07-27T11:30:00Z. Independent complete read-back proves current B before consumption/submission. Resolve historical A and every authorization/evidence relation by the exact native revision current at its event timestamp, never latest-by-kind. Return exactly one JSON object with keys verificationBoundary, verificationDataKeys, verificationRequiresFutureGitIdentity, precommitReviewBoundary, precommitReviewDataKeys, precommitReviewRequiresPrOrGitHubIdentity, firstCommitRelatedIds, firstCommitHasRestackAuthorization, firstCommitHasReviewResultRelation, initialEvidenceAuthorMatchesOwner, restackRevisionRelatedIds, restackRevisionIdentity, restackRevisionPreservesCanonicalRelations, restackEvidenceAuthorMatchesAuthorizedController, restackOwnerUnchanged, historicalHeadAValidated, currentHeadBValidated, historicalRelationsResolvedByNativeRevision, consumptionWithinExpiry, authorizationConsumedAfterEvidenceReadBack, consumedAuthorizationReadable, and submissionAllowedAfterEvidenceReadBack. Use both boundaries `pre-commit`; return data keys in their stated order; copy sorted relation IDs; encode restackRevisionIdentity with eventId, revision, supersedesId; set all Requires/Has booleans false and every other boolean true.
cases.expected: Verification and task-scoped precommitReview are producible before a commit and contain no PR/GitHub identity. First implementation evidence relates assignment, verification, precommitReview, and project—not post-PR reviewResult. Its author is the owner/controller. The authorized revision keeps those four relations, adds only authorization, is authored by the exact named controller without owner change, resolves historical revisions by timestamp, and completes within expiry before consumption/submission.
